answer: A berth on the jetty needs a quartz crystal, and the jetty's single lattice vat grows one only when its holder whispers a seed into it: one seed per season, and holders with no crystal are served before anyone holding a stack. An honest newcomer waits one season; an operator running a thousand identities waits a thousand seasons before it holds them all at once, however it splits into fresh wallets. A grown crystal answers only the whisper that seeded it, so no fork or clone can borrow one.
